message: Being up on stage gets me all excited.
Coming up this far, the crowd has grown too, and their gazes feel great. Well, Sensei’s anxious gaze is the strongest one, though.
……I’ve gotten stronger. I think that’s all thanks to Sensei and everyone else.
And just like that, Arakawa-senpai appeared right before me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Your turn, huh... I hate the look on your face.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Senpai, you sure are hostile toward me, aren't you? Did I ever do anything to you?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Oh, don’t worry. You didn’t do a damn thing.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「It’s just that I hate people who were born into rich families and grew up pampered without ever having to struggle.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’m talking about you, you little miss of the Tobe Family.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What is that, talk about collateral damage.」
Just because I was born rich doesn't mean I haven't known any struggle, so I wish she’d stop slapping these weird labels on me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’ve had my fair share of struggles too, you know~」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Fair share... haha, ‘fair share.’ Well, I’m sure it’s nothing much.」
That ticked me off.

name: Ririmu
message: 「……Alright then. If that’s how it is, I’ll teach you—with this blade.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’ll let you take the first move. Come at me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh? Is that what ‘senior’s composure’ looks like?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Wouldn't be any fun if you got taken down in one hit, would it？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Your dull little blade wouldn't hurt or tickle me no matter how many times it hits, so go ahead and throw everything you've got.」

name: Umpire
message: 「Both parties, take your stances！」
I draw my Origami and point the tip at Arakawa-senpai’s face.

name: Ririmu
message: （Ah, man, I am completely being looked down on, aren't I.）
It pisses me off a little.

name: Ririmu
message: （If you’re gonna talk that big, you’d better be ready to take it. I’m not holding anything back...！）

name: Umpire
message: 「……Begin！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright then... I’ll show you right from the start！」
Right after the Umpire’s voice echoed, I unleashed my phantom！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I come—World is Mine！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh？ What the hell did you just do, you bastard...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’ll find out soon enough！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「—Hiyah！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Coming at me with that cheap trick...！？」
Slicing from the left at the opponent who just dealt with the phantom attacking from the right！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, where are you looking！?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tsk, I was wondering why my opponents in your matches were moving so strangely... so this is what it’s all about！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, hey, I went through all the trouble of doing this ‘for you,’ Senpai, shouldn't you be a little more happy about it！？」
Yeah, Arakawa-senpai might not be that much of a tough opponent after all. She’s not as rock-solid as Asahi, either.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch, what an annoying technique you’ve got there...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Idiot, it’s not that way！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on, try and dodge this！！」
While confusing her with phantoms, I keep landing small, repeated slashes.
A single full-powered strike would be scary if it landed, but as long as I don’t get greedy and try to land deep cuts, it’ll never hit.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ugh, another fake！?」

name: Ririmu
message: （Man, this is totally one-sided, isn't it？）

name: Ririmu
message: 「How about this！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don’t screw with me, don’t you look down on me！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「How’s that? I hit you, didn't I！」

name: Ririmu
message: （Ghhh, that strength is insane！ It's like Sensei’s...！！）
I came at her from behind with both hands at full power, while Senpai only used one hand, and she was in the middle of turning around, too.

name: Ririmu
message: （...And yet, I’m the one who got sent flying！）

name: Ririmu
message: （This is bad, just one good hit and the tables might turn.）
I’m shivering at that incredible raw power.

name: Ririmu
message: （Maybe Sensei was right. Evasion is key.）
Safe and certain, but attack quickly without holding back.

name: Ririmu
message: （Man, she’s even more dangerous than I expected...）
Even though I was landing almost everything until a moment ago, she’s gradually starting to adjust to me.
She intentionally takes strikes that won't be fatal to get a read on the space, then slashes right through it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ha! You really think that’s gonna hit me？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If it connects, it’s over, isn’t it？ You think you can keep dodging forever？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Obviously！」

name: Ririmu
message: （Halfway there… I’m gonna wear her down just like this！）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch… you rich little princess, getting all cocky…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「'Rich, rich,' that’s all you say! Why are you so obsessed with money anyway!？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You know damn well why.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Seeing people like you who’ve never known a day of hunger walking around with that high-and-mighty look on your face—it’s just infuriating！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Waving a stick around to kill time, dressing yourself up in that flashy outfit…！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「People like you mistake the strength bought with money for your own damn power.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hah, is that sour grapes？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「…While you were using your wealth to boss people around, I was drinking mud water and grinding my life away just to survive.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So what！？ Your personal sob story, Senpai, has nothing to do with me！」
As I retorted, her entire presence shifted.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, I guess it’s got nothin’ to do with you… but it’s got everything to do with me.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「So just shut up and let me eat you.」
Killer intent—I forced my body, which had almost frozen in an instant, to move. A split second later, a slash cut through the space where I’d just been.

name: Ririmu
message: （This one… she’s not playing with a full deck…！）
Eyes like a starving beast glare down at me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「…As if! There’s no way I’m losing to someone like you!」
I’d already worn down most of her Barrier Jacket; it would be over in a moment.
Logically, I should be able to win from here, but something inside me is screaming that something is wrong.

name: Ririmu
message: （…She really isn't the type of opponent I can hold back against！）
Then I'll just keep pressing the attack！

name: Ririmu
message: 「There’s nothing more pathetic than losing while trying to act cool…！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m dragging you into my world—Butterfly Effect！！！」
The world changes. It begins to be dyed in the colors of my world.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, what do you think！ This is my world. Everything goes exactly how I say.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...How stupid. It's just a cheap imitation, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Care to repeat that？ Don't you dare look down on my worldview！」
My world makes everything go mad.
Right is left, and up is down.
I intend to swing my right arm, but my left one goes up. The ground under my right foot suddenly disappears as I step forward.
In this space where anything goes, I’m the only one who can move freely！

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is it... the end for you！」
I create a massive number of illusory copies of myself and launch a simultaneous attack.
A wide, uncontrolled swing like that isn't going to hit me. I’ll shower her with countless blades and shred her Barrier Jacket to pieces！

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ugh, what the hell is this...!」
Arakawa-senpai drops to one knee.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nice, how’s that for ya！！」
Win, just like always！
...Or so I thought for a split second.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't let your guard down, Ririmu！ It's not over yet！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch... that actually stung a little...」
I should have shredded it completely, and yet.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...You're actually getting back up. Still want more？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I thought you were just some weakling relying on a cheap imitation, but you’re actually not half bad.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm relieved. Looks like this might actually be fun.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, what about senpai's Barrier Jacket...？」

name: Iori
message: 「...It's regenerating.」

name: Iori
message: 「We have no choice but to take her down again... Stay focused, Ririmu！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know that already！」
Even though she’s staggering, Arakawa-senpai readies her nagamaki.

name: Sonomi
message: 「But seriously, all your attacks are way too lukewarm. Give me a real hit with some muscle behind it.」
Even though I’d heard about this beforehand.
It makes no sense that the Barrier Jacket I shredded is still there.
She’s being beaten one-sidedly, so how can she still keep that look on her face?

name: Ririmu
message: 「What is up with this person? It's creeping me out...！」
It wasn't out of fear that I instinctively took a step back. It was because I felt an indescribable, unsettling eeriness.

name: Ririmu
message: （That's all... yes, that's all it is!）

name: Iori
message: 「So this is the nature of her Tenju...」
Right after I thought she was defeated, Arakawa's VF value recovered.
VF value—short for Vital Force Field value.
This is the figure indicating the strength of a Barrier Jacket, a value that can be monitored externally.
The VF value of a Barrier Jacket, activated by the simultaneous use of Origami and Spirit-Type Armament, is constantly monitored during a match.
If a contestant's VF value falls below the threshold during a match, their loss is confirmed, and the match ends there.
It is a logical rule, given that if the Barrier Jacket is lost, there's a risk of fatality.
And Ririmu's attack had certainly depleted Arakawa's Barrier Jacket.
Even accounting for the slight lag in sensor readings, at that moment, the VF value reached a negative figure—below the threshold.
Yet, despite the significant drop, the Barrier Jacket recovered in the blink of an eye.
It now maintains a baseline just slightly lower than the normal value. It is a fluctuation in numbers that is absolutely impossible under normal circumstances.

name: Iori
message: 「How could such a thing... even happen？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... no matter how many times I take her down...！」
Even while I was lost in thought, Ririmu kept landing hits. Considering the VF values, she should have gone down at least twice already.
In reality, she does go down—only for her Barrier Jacket to revive each time, causing the person I should have defeated to simply stand back up.

name: Iori
message: 「Ah... could it be... this is...！」
A phrase I heard in the past flashes through my mind. He was obsessed with researching special Tenju within the Tenju Special Forces.
It was a story about an Ikusabito who would revive no matter how many times they were struck down—

name: Iori
message: 「I've got it... this is a special Tenju. The name he gave it was... I believe it was 'Yomigaeri'...！」
When one's body and mind are driven to their absolute limit, they revive, gaining strength proportional to the damage received.
They say a bearer of such a ridiculous, almost joke-like special Tenju once existed in Japan.

name: Iori
message: 「Is it possible that she is a bearer of the 'Yomigaeri' Tenju...？」
However, looking at the numbers, it doesn't seem like she is reviving with doubled strength proportional to the damage taken.
Special Tenju characteristics vary depending on the bearer. It's not identical, but she must possess a very similar aptitude.

name: Iori
message: 「Either way, this is going to be trouble...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Damn it, just go down already...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, curse your own pathetic ass for not being able to take me down！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haa, haah...！ Just how tough are you...！」
I put some distance between us and take a deep breath. Not good... I'm starting to feel really winded...
Even so, I can still fight.
Sensei had packed extra running into my training, saying I needed to build up more stamina.
Back then I was thinking, 'This sucks, give me a break,' but right now I'm nothing but grateful.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm starting to get pretty used to this cheap-ass 'worldview' of yours.」
She's the one who's all beat up, and I'm the one on the offensive, so it makes zero sense that I'm the one getting cornered.
Arakawa-paisen is whipping her nagamaki around like a baton.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't call it cheap when you don't even get it...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Over here... no, that's a feint—it's over here, right？ Hraaah！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I told you, wrong again！ Idiot！！」
Even when I hit her with illusions, she doesn't drop it—she just keeps spinning it, and the moment she senses an attack, she throws a full-power counter in that direction.
She's probably just taking wild guesses, but if one connects I'm screwed, so I have no choice but to dodge.
As a result, I end up wasting movements and attacks, wearing myself out even faster. No matter how far we go, it's just back and forth.
Her strikes have grazed me a few times, sure, but I haven't taken a single direct hit.
Which makes it totally baffling how visibly worn down my Barrier Jacket is getting.
Meanwhile, I've already knocked Arakawa-paisen down more than five times. She's gotta be close to her limit too.
—If I don't believe that, I won't be able to keep going.

name: Ririmu
message: （Ugh, this has turned into a total slog！ It's messy and totally not cute. My absolute least favorite way to fight）
Still, I refuse to lose.

name: Ririmu
message: （Like hell I'm gonna lose to someone who trashes my worldview！）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, already out of breath? We're just getting started, ya know?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haaah, haa... You're the one who's falling apart here！」

name: Ririmu
message: （Agh, dammit... If I knew it'd come to this, I would've done way more running drills）
Not that complaining helps now. It's all on me, anyway.

name: Ririmu
message: （Just gotta do what I can right now！）
If I can't take her down in one hit, then I'll do it in five, or ten.
With her Barrier Jacket worn down this much, it's overkill.
Common sense says you hold back because it's dangerous, but.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’ll never, ever do that！！！」
I dodge her horizontally swept nagamaki by a hair’s breadth, step into her range, use a phantom clone, and unleash a full-power multi-hit combo.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’ll land as many as it takes...！」
It doesn't matter if I can hear the sound of her Barrier Jacket shattering.
Because the opponent is still moving. Every time I slash her, for some reason, her Barrier Jacket keeps regenerating.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Keep going, keep going...！！！」
I don’t hesitate to unleash attacks that would be fatal if the jacket weren't regenerating.
I rain down more blades than even I can count upon Arakawa-senpai, who has been deceived by my all-out illusion.

name: Ririmu
message: 「With this, it’s overrrrrrr！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Urgh, uaaah...！！」
Countless attacks rain down all over my body.
The impact coming from angles completely different from where I’m focused causes damage to accumulate faster than I expected.
I take a direct slash to the head, and my consciousness fades. Through the haze, I suddenly hear a voice from the past.

name: Mentor
message: 「You have talent.」
...It was the voice of my mentor.

name: Mentor
message: 「What do you think? Don't you want to try Jindou?」

name: Mentor
message: 「Don't worry about the tuition.」

name: Mentor
message: 「It’s kind of a hobby of mine to help nurture the talent I find.」

name: Mentor
message: 「Come if you want to. I’ll train you.」

name: Sonomi
message: （Even though I told him I didn't have any money, he just said that. In the end, he really never took a single cent from me...）
I was born into a poor family in the countryside and grew up taking care of my younger siblings.
Living in extreme poverty, I faced all sorts of ugly things. I had to become strong to protect my little siblings.
Because if I didn't, I wouldn't have survived. I did whatever it took just to put food on the table.
It was while I was rampaging like that that I met my mentor. And that was how I became able to perform Jindou.
Meeting my Origami was the first moment in my life where I felt like it was worth living.
I didn't go to school, but I went to the dojo every single day. I have nothing but gratitude for the mentor who taught me without asking for a dime.

name: Mentor
message: 「...Right, why don't you try going to Murakumo Academy？」

name: Master
message: 「The facilities over there are much better equipped than here. You'll have rivals, too. You can grow even stronger than you are now.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Like I told ya, we don't got that kinda cash. ...I mean, sure, I'd like to go and all, but...」

name: Master
message: 「Don't worry. I'll cover the money.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Whoa, hold on, I appreciate it and all, but I got no way of payin' you back.」

name: Master
message: 「You're definitely going to become a pro Jindou fighter, Sonomi. Once you make it, you can pay me back then.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...And what if I don't make it?」

name: Master
message: 「Then you don't have to pay me back.」

name: Master
message: 「As long as you seize a future of your own, that's all I ask.」
With those words, Master casually fronted a sum that was by no means small.

name: Sonomi
message: （I'd never met anyone who saw that much worth in me before.）

name: Sonomi
message: （If only to repay Master, I'm never gonna give up. I'm gonna become a pro Jindou fighter, no matter what...！！）
...Yeah, that's why.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Like hell I'm gonna go down in a place like this...！！」
My whole body ached—I was already beat to hell.

name: Sonomi
message: （I don't give a damn... I'm used to this kinda thing.）
This pain is what tells me I'm "alive."

name: Sonomi
message: （All I know how to do anyway is grip a blade and slug it out—that's the only way I know how to live.）
Master told me to take care of myself and all that, yeah.
My life's just something that happened to be lying around on the side of the road—that's all it's worth, ain't it?
I ain't got a single thing to lose.

name: Sonomi
message: （Then I'll claw and struggle until I'm worn down and shattered to pieces—！！！）
A faint roar echoes right by my ears.
It's a familiar sound. Neither the searing pain shooting through my body nor the exhaustion goes away.
Just sheer grit. Only the will to fight kept me on my feet.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Hey, sorry to keep ya waiting. The match ain't over yet, is it...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way... How many times does this make now...！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Who cares how many times it takes? All that matters is who's left standing at the end.」

name: Sonomi
message: （Ah, this is fun... So damn fun.）
I can still go. I can push even harder. None of the pain or misery can hold a candle to how fun Jindou is.
I'm so thrilled I can keep going in this match, I can't even stand it.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Alright, let's keep this going...！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're crazy, you're actually insane...！」
Tobe looks at me with a terrified expression as I call out to her.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, what would someone like you know about this...！！」
As if someone like you could ever understand the bitterness and agony I've tasted...！！
I tilt my head with a grin, hoisting my nagamaki over my shoulder, and take a step forward.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why... hey, why won't you go down...！！」
—Just then, the illusions around us began to warp.
The landscape melted away, skulls rose from the darkness, and skeletal hands reached out to grab my ankles.
Countless arms stretched out from a puddle of pitch-black sludge, and the surroundings began to take on a hellish appearance.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wh-what... what is this...！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha... why ask me? This is your illusion, isn't it?」
Skeletons, monsters... living corpses？ I see, so that's how she sees me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I suppose my role here is... a <d0100>zombie</d>...」
The moment I said it, the flesh on my arms melted away.
Immediately following a heat so intense it made my body stiffen, the exposed bone sent a chill down to my very core.
Every step I took was met with a sharp, stabbing pain, as if countless needles had been driven into my feet.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch... so you're going to go to the trouble of messing with my pain receptors, too. So this isn't just a simple theater...」
A sensation like being clawed all over my body rippled through me. A chill ran down my spine.
But it seemed I wasn't the only one.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ow-oww... guhh, wh-what is this...！ This isn't my... my vision of the world...！！」
Tobe was screaming as she was racked by pain all over her body.

name: Sonomi
message: （Could it be she can't control her own power? ...I see, it's running wild.）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Stop it, enough of this... make it stop...！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, hey, don't be such a waste and get rid of it. You went through the trouble of creating these illusions, right？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Then let's enjoy them together a little longer...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ar-are you stupid? There's no way I could enjoy this...!」
Even as she said it, a centipede crawled up her face, and she screamed as she swatted it away.

name: Ririmu
message: 「It hurts, it hurts... why, how did it come to this...！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Soft... don’t go crying over something like this.」
I don’t know how these illusions work, but surely, you can’t create something you don’t know.
You shouldn't be able to inflict a pain you’ve never experienced.
Maybe that’s why—even though it looked freakishly real, the pain it dealt felt remarkably cheap.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wh-why the hell can you keep such a calm face！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha... stuff like this, for me, it’s just routine.」
The burning heat of melting flesh isn't as intense as the heat of a red-hot iron pipe pressed directly into my skin.
The bone-chilling cold isn't as bad as spending a night out in the winter rain.
The piercing pain isn't as bad as the time my old man stabbed me all over with a kitchen knife.
Compared to what I’ve tasted until now, such cheap pain as this is no different than a mosquito bite.
Cutting through the illusion, I take one step after another, closing in on Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Stop it, don’t come closer！！」
A slash of black darkness darts out, piercing my body. But that’s it.
There’s pain, but my body isn’t actually being destroyed.
If your bones are broken, you can’t move no matter how much pain you endure. She probably doesn’t have that kind of experience.
A hot, wincing sting.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha... something like this is just a gentle breeze.」
The extending dark slash is an illusion. Maybe she just swung her weapon in the air right there.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I told you not to come here！！！」
I walk on, ignoring her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why, why won’t you just go down...！！！」
The moment I enter her range, Tobe raises her Origami.
I don’t bother dodging, taking the slash with my body, and grab Tobe’s arm firmly.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Gotcha！」
A grin creeps onto my face, unbidden.
I press the blade that cut through nothing so many times during this match against Tobe’s throat.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...This pathetic game of house is over, Tobe Ririmu！！」
I’m sick of watching you make a fool of yourself in your own illusions, and I’m sick of this whole pathetic world.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, gaaaaaaahhhhhhh...！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「The rest of it, you can see on your own...！！」
Pressing the blade against the throat, pulling it back slowly—

name: Sonomi
message: 「RAAAAAAAGHHHHHH！！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「That’s it！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「...Winner, Arakawa Sonomi！！！」
The illusion dissipated, and the Umpire's voice echoed through the area.

name: Sonomi
message: （So it’s over, huh...）
As I carelessly let go, Tobe collapsed right there on the spot.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu！！！」
Teach came running over in a panic.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Yo, that was a pretty fun match, Teach. Never thought she'd be able to use illusions.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「But I wanted a little more of a challenge. Make sure you train her better for next time.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm sorry, but I don't have time to talk to you right now. If you'll excuse me.」
After saying that, Teach carried Ririmu away.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Tch, boring.」
Once the match is over, you're dragged right back to reality. The only fun is while the fight's going on.

name: Sonomi
message: （...Fun times sure fly by.）
Isn't there anyone else out there who can give me a real fight...
